{{Top|leg}}
'''Djarri''' was a [[Devaronian/Legends|Devaronian]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who owned the [[Black Hole (Vergesso Base)|Black Hole]], a [[Cantina/Legends|bar]] in the [[Vergesso Base]] [[Shadowport/Legends|shadowport]] that catered to [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] and [[Privateer/Legends|privateers]].

This clientele grew so despite his will, but after his bar became their favorite place, he couldn't do anything about it. He made it clear to them however that he would resolve to [[Base Operations Center|Ops]] security if they brought trouble to the place or its staff.
